title: Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing — Release at the End of the State Requirement
content:
## Terms

A Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing may be released at the customer's request once the state's requirement has ended. Where the certificate sends a release notice, a release notice is transmitted to the state.

## Earliest release date

A filing is released only when the request comes no earlier than the certificate's earliest-release days — 1 calendar day on every certificate — after the required-through date on the state order.

- **Clock start:** the required-through date on the state order the filing answers, as the order record shows it. That date is day 0.
- **Counting:** calendar days. A request on the first day after the required-through date qualifies.
- **Before then:** a release would leave the driver without proof and is declined. The customer may instead keep the certificate, which continues through renewals without refiling.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Required-through date on the order | Request date | Day | Release |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 June | 29 June | −1 | Declined |
| 30 June | 30 June | 0 | Declined |
| 30 June | 1 July | 1 | Qualifies |
| 30 June | 15 August | 46 | Qualifies |

## Questions answered

**The customer says the court told them the requirement is over early.** The decision rests on the required-through date on the state order on file; a date the record does not show does not qualify the request.

**What if the customer keeps the certificate instead?** It continues through renewals until it is cancelled or released.
